card.name: Linking words before lung-function measures
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "in", "with", "for" and "decreased" just before respiratory measures like DLco, oxygen saturation, FEV1 or respiratory symptoms, in lung-toxicity warnings.

modes.label: Linker before respiratory symptoms
modes.description: "of" after worsening, ahead of respiratory symptoms in interstitial lung disease warnings.

modes.label: Decrease before a lung measure
modes.description: "decreased" or a linker right before DLco, oxygen saturation or respiratory drive.
modes.example: pulmonary function tests revealed a restrictive pattern with<< decreased>> DLco.
